plugins.name: Story Writer
plugins.description: A per-project Story tab: a setup wizard (premise, plot, setting, characters, relationships, themes, endings, style rules, banned words; each 'I write it', 'AI drafts, I edit' or 'AI generates') and a live dashboard for a card-driven writing pipeline. Records, then a pilot chapter with a fresh-session cold read and fix, an owner approve/feedback gate, parallel chapters (each cold-read and fixed), structure/character/pacing/line/copyedit review passes and export. Chapters and records are written to story/ in the project repo.
plugins.author: firestar
